data.name: Melisandra
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words meli (honey) and andros (man), Melisandra means sweet one or honey for a woman. In Greek mythology, Melisande was a priestess and prophetess, revered for her divine insights.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a sweet and divine connection to the gods.
